mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post ( title, content, u_id, like_count, category, game_id, view_count, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{uId}, 0, #{category}, ( SELECT game_id FROM game_list WHERE UPPER(game_alias) = UPPER(#{gameAlias}) ), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE p_id = #{pId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.p_id, p.title, p.content, p.category, p.like_count, p.view_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.u_id, u.nickname, g.game_id, g.game_name, g.game_alias FROM post p JOIN user_info u ON p.u_id = u.u_id JOIN game_list g ON p.game_id = g.game_id WHERE p.p_id = #{pId} AND UPPER(g.game_alias) = UPPER(#{gameAlias})
SELECT m_id, media_url, media_order, p_id, media_type FROM media WHERE p_id = #{pId} ORDER BY media_order ASC

SELECT c.c_id, c."content", c.like_count, c.p_id, c.u_id, c.parent_c_id, c.created_at, c.updated_at, u.nickname FROM comments c JOIN user_info u ON c.u_id = u.u_id WHERE c.p_id = #{pId} ORDER BY COALESCE(c.parent_c_id, c.c_id) ASC, c.c_id ASC

SELECT p_id AS pId, category, title, created_at AS createdAt, view_count AS viewCount, like_count AS likeCount, g.game_alias AS gameAlias FROM post p JOIN game_List g ON p.game_id = g.game_id WHERE u_id = #{loginUserId} ORDER BY p_id DESC

SELECT p.p_id AS pid,
p.title, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.like_count AS likeCount, g.game_alias AS gameAlias FROM post p JOIN game_list g ON p.game_id = g.game_id JOIN like_history l ON l.p_id = p.p_id WHERE l.u_id = #{loginUserId} ORDER BY p.like_count DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE p_id = #{pId} AND u_id = #{uId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO like_history (u_id, p_id, c_id) VALUES (#{uId}, #{pId}, NULL)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM like_history WHERE p_id = #{pId} AND u_id = #{uId}
